answer: A payout is split so that 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The nebula schedule is applied in juniper and atlas exposes each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2182 identities would post 4937 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
